title: Impeaching Peter Brian Hegseth, Secretary of Defense, for high crimes and misdemeanors.
latestAction: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

actions.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to refer Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 211 - 204 (Roll no. 317).
The previous question on the motion to refer was ordered without objection.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on motion to refer H. Res. 1655.
Mr. Issa moved to refer to the Judiciary. (CR H6132)
Considered as privileged matter. (consideration: CR H6126-6133; text: CR H6126-6132)

QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE - Mr. Massie rose to a question of the privileges of the House and offered the resolution. The Chair directed the Clerk to report the resolution. Upon examination of the resolution, the Chair determined that the resolution did constitute a question of the privileges of the House.
